title: What Echo Hunter's SAG-AFTRA sign-off actually means
excerpt: Echo Hunter was produced with explicit performer consent and guild sign-off for re-rendering a live performance with Arcana AI's video model.
body: Echo Hunter was produced with explicit performer consent and guild sign-off for re-rendering a live performance with Arcana AI's video model — a template other AI productions using a real actor's likeness are likely to follow as the space matures. We break down what was agreed to, and what it doesn't cover.
